answer: ESCALATING PER-ACTION COST. Every repeated action from the same identity multiplies its own fee: fee_n = 0.05 x 1.8^n POA, charged per identity rather than pooled across a farm. A ring of 40 sybils firing 12 actions each to fake consensus pays about 40 x 162 POA = 6,480 POA, versus 65 POA for a genuine island cluster doing the same work once. A velvet truce of idle dormancy doesn't help: the penalty atlas resets the multiplier only after 30 silent epochs, so cycling sybils still owe reactivation surcharges, never reaching zero cost.
